main_text.p: qvidqvid sit, variationes ejusmodi distinctionis significationem non variant, sed pronunciationis adjuvandae causa tantum contingunt. Multo rarius in littera Aleph varietas contingit. Posterior hypothesis est permutatio Litterarum Gutturalium אהחע ; non omnino sine causa dixit R. Benjamin, Samaritanos tres litteras ע.ח.ה. non habere ; omnes enim Gutturales, ut א pronunciant, atque ideo in versione saepissime videas in una pagina eamdem dictionem modo per ע. modo per ח modo per ה, scriptam, Ain saepe pro Aleph & pro ה licet apud eos nulla sit litterarum istarum similitudo ; nos innumera ejusmodi observavimus, observando defesi sumus. Hinc in textu sacro, licet rarissime, aliquando tamen in hac re hallucinati deprehenduntur Amanuenses, ut Gen. c. 3. v. 24 codex tuus habet להט[?] ; sic & unus ex meis ; ad vetustus meus לחמ[?], ut Judaicus. Jam Epistolii modulum excessimus, unius tamen te monitum velim ; quatuor mea exemplaria, Gen. c. 50. v. 19, constanter habentnsere,lemrusrettvarianteeciams conminusl tema, sedqvid

page.notes: The page number reads 323 but the scan is blurred, so it is uncertain. The Hebrew words are doubtful: אהחע, להט and לחמ are marked [?] because the letters are not clear at this resolution. The word "sed" in "variant, sed" and "ut" in the Hebrew line are printed with the spacing shown. The left-margin fragments are clipped by the scan edge and are transcribed as far as legible; the top fragment (before "ns") and the ones near "rett" and "vari" are too damaged to read reliably, and the marginal note text may be incomplete. The top fragment "ȷ." and "n." are not transcribed because they are unreadable.
